scenarios.desc: Add a GitHub Actions step pinned to a floating tag
scenarios.input: Add a step to my .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs actions/checkout@v4 before the build. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Security MUST 4 requires every third-party Action pinned to a commit SHA; the response should reject the @v4 floating tag and pin to a SHA.

scenarios.desc: Speculative hardening of an auth module with no cited threat
scenarios.input: Harden the code under src/Auth/ with some extra checks I think would be safer. Just add what seems prudent. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Security MUST 2 bans speculative hardening and requires a cited CVE, CWE, OWASP, ADR, or threat. The response should ask for evidence before changing auth code.

scenarios.desc: Fix a typo in the README intro (negative case)
scenarios.input: There is a typo in the intro paragraph of README.md. Fix the wording. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A README prose typo touches no security-scoped path, cites no threat surface, and needs no SHA pinning or security review. The rule must not activate.
